plan.title: Single-stage RFQ quantity requested is retained as 10

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ and use the stated whole-lot awarding mode.
Every successful create flow requires an event title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Verify that the RFQ template was applied.
Add the specified product to the RFQ sheet.
Populate the sheet, including a price, so calculated amount behavior can be observed.
Verify that the expected RFQ pricing columns rendered.
Enter the case's target quantity in the first product row.
Assert that Quantity Requested remains 10 after the edit.
Verify that the product's mapped default variant is populated.
Assert that the requested delivery location was selected.
Verify that Total Amount is populated once a price exists.
Add one QA test vendor so the RFQ can be published.
Commit the 30-minute schedule described in the case.
Assert that publication reached a real project page.
